item.title: Rising air injection rates boost compressed air energy storage efficiency
item.description: PV Magazine — Chinese researchers have analyzed how different air injection strategies affect energy storage rates and heat losses in compressed air energy storage caverns. They found that a linearly increasing air flow rate can raise the energy storage rate from 85.5% to 87.5% compared with constant-rate injection.

item.title: Italy raises Macse energy storage auction premium cap from €22,000 to €27,000/MWh
item.description: PV Magazine — Italy’s energy regulator, Arera, has raised the MACSE auction premium cap to €27,000/MWh per year, up from €22,000/MWh proposed in July, mainly due to higher benchmark investment costs. The new cap affects project economics and guarantees, while developers must weigh the 15-year fixed premium against potential merchant revenues when setting their bids.

item.title: Austria to enable peer-to-peer electricity sharing from October
item.description: PV Magazine — Austria will introduce peer-to-peer electricity sharing from Oct. 5, initially allowing participation between metering points served by the same grid operator. Reduced grid charges for peer-to-peer arrangements are expected to take effect from January 2027, with nationwide implementation planned from April 2027.
